QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: serialDevice
QGC.MetaData.Facts.longDesc: Explicitly selected receiver port. Generic USB serial adapters are not automatically identified as GNSS receivers.
QGC.MetaData.Facts.label: Serial device

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: serialBaudRate
QGC.MetaData.Facts.longDesc: Serial rate for an explicitly selected receiver. Passive input requires the rate already configured on the receiver.
QGC.MetaData.Facts.label: Baud rate

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: surveyInAccuracyLimit
QGC.MetaData.Facts.longDesc: Receiver-specific survey accuracy limit. Quectel applies this limit to individual observations, not to guaranteed final position accuracy.
QGC.MetaData.Facts.label: Survey in accuracy

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: surveyInMinObservationDuration
QGC.MetaData.Facts.longDesc: Defines the minimum observation time for the position calculation. Quectel counts accepted 1 Hz observations; elapsed time can be longer.
QGC.MetaData.Facts.label: Min observation time

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: receiverAveragingDuration
QGC.MetaData.Facts.longDesc: Maximum receiver-managed averaging time. This mode does not guarantee a position accuracy.
QGC.MetaData.Facts.label: Maximum averaging time

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: useFixedBasePosition
QGC.MetaData.Facts.longDesc: Specify the RTK base mode: accuracy-controlled survey-in, fixed position, or receiver-managed averaging without an accuracy guarantee.
QGC.MetaData.Facts.label: Use specified base mode

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: fixedBasePositionLatitude
QGC.MetaData.Facts.longDesc: Defines the latitude of the fixed RTK base position.
QGC.MetaData.Facts.label: Base Position Latitude

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: fixedBasePositionLongitude
QGC.MetaData.Facts.longDesc: Defines the longitude of the fixed RTK base position.
QGC.MetaData.Facts.label: Base Position Longitude

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: fixedBasePositionAltitude
QGC.MetaData.Facts.longDesc: Defines the altitude of the fixed RTK base position.
QGC.MetaData.Facts.label: Base Position Alt (WGS84)

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: fixedBasePositionAccuracy
QGC.MetaData.Facts.longDesc: Defines the accuracy of the fixed RTK base position.
QGC.MetaData.Facts.label: Base Position Accuracy
